 Indian stinging nettle (Tragia involucrata) 
 Vasa (Adhatoda vasica)

 Ginger (Zingiber officinalis)

 Clean and crush all the ingredients to form a coarse powder and add it to 16 times water and boil it till it reduces to 1/4th its actual amount and get it off the flame and let it cool. Filter this decoction and keep the filtrate in tinted glass bottles.

Over dosage may cause gastritis. Patients who already suffer from gastritis might see worsened gastritis.

fullContent:
Rasnairandadi Kashayam – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference: Sahasrayoga Kashaya Prakarna 
 Introduction 
 Rasnairandadi Kashayam is a herbal formulation. It can be used to cure locked jaw, lower back ache, pain in flanks etc. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Rasna (Pluchea lanceolata) 
 Castor (Ricinus communis) 
 Bala (Sida cordifolia) 
 Porcupine flower (Barleria prionitis) 
 Shatavari (Asparagus racemosus) 
 Indian stinging nettle (Tragia involucrata) 
 Vasa (Adhatoda vasica) 
 Tinospora (Tinospora cordifolia) 
 Himalayan cedar (Cedrus deodara) 
 Aconites (Aconitum heterophyllum) 
 Ghana (Cyperus rotundus) 
 Hygrophila (Asteracantha longifolia) 
 Spiked ginger lily (Hedychium spicatum) 
 Ginger (Zingiber officinalis) 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Clean and crush all the ingredients to form a coarse powder and add it to 16 times water and boil it till it reduces to 1/4th its actual amount and get it off the flame and let it cool. Filter this decoction and keep the filtrate in tinted glass bottles. 
 Dosage 
 10 to 15 ml twice daily before meals. Equal amount of water can be added before consuming. 
 Indications 
 
 Arthritis 
 Back pain 
 Inflammation 
 Lumbar spondylitis 
 Swelling 
 Pain due to injury 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 Over dosage may cause gastritis. Patients who already suffer from gastritis might see worsened gastritis. 
 It should be consumed under strict medical supervision. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
